rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance – source of income and protected-category discrimination
rules.requirement: Landlords, sellers and rental agents may not discriminate in viewing or renting an apartment or in terms and conditions of tenancy based on protected categories, including source of income (which includes Section 8 and public benefits). They may use any reasonable selection standard, such as ability to pay rent, as long as it is applied equally and uniformly to all applicants.
rules.coverage_text: Real estate transactions in Cambridge, including viewing or renting an apartment and terms and conditions of tenancy; applies to landlords, sellers and rental agents.
rules.exemptions: Exemption for 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there.
rules.penalty: After hearing, the Commission may file a criminal complaint in District Court, levy civil fines of up to $300 for each violation, file a civil complaint in Superior Court seeking injunctive relief, and seek an award of damages, expenses and other relief.
rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
